Cc: samantha.cruz@hearthwell.com
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Hearthwell exec day — arrival details & requirements

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for putting this together. Quick note as we finalize schedules for Thursday: the CFO (Mark Hollis) and Head of Platform (Samantha) will arrive on separate flights. Can you confirm:

- Reception/escort on arrival (eta: Mark 09:10, Samantha 11:40)
- Secure room with wired network + HDMI + Apple TV backup
- Onsite point of contact for laptop/networking (we need host credentials for one guest laptop)
- NDA and data handling reminders for the demo environment

I've attached our attendee list and a short meeting goals memo. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Graham
Graham Ellis
Director, Strategy — Hearthwell Financial

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hearthwell exec day — arrival details & requirements

Hi Graham — great to see this shaping up. Draft run-of-show below and a short checklist. Laura (EA Ops) will own onsite escort and AV. Monica will coordinate badges and the secure room access.

Draft run-of-show (Thursday 3/15)
- 08:15 — Redwood ops and HWL team on site (prep)
- 09:00 — Mark arrives; escort to secure conference 3B; coffee available
- 09:30 — 1:1 with Redwood CEO (30m) + demo arrival setup (30m)
- 11:30 — Samantha arrives; joint leadership workshop 12:00–14:00 (lunch provided)
- 14:30 — Tech deep-dive and staging area (we'll use the secure demo VLAN)
- 16:00 — Wrap & next steps

Checklist for us to confirm:
- Wired port + test laptop provisioning (IT will pre-provision an isolated VLAN)
- HDMI + AppleTV + spare dongles (we'll keep HDMI->USB-C, HDMI->Lightning)
- Host guest Wi-Fi credentials (monica will provide)
- Signed CNDA for demo data (Samantha, can you confirm if you want ours or yours to be used?)

Attachments I just added: Exec_Inbound_Arrival_List.xlsx and a short RoS for the session. 

Laura — can you confirm escort assignments, pick-up logistics, and vendor AV contact? Monica — please share badge pickup time and secure-room access procedure.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0187
Attachments: Exec_Inbound_Arrival_List.xlsx; Hearthwell_Meeting_RoS.pdf
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, Graham Ellis <g.ellis@hearthwell.com>, Samantha Cruz <s.cruz@hearthwell.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hearthwell exec day — arrival details & requirements

Thanks — short updates and confirmations: 

1) Escort & pick-up- Mark (09:10) — Meet & greet at curb, escorted by Vanessa Ortiz (onsite ambassador). ETA note: driver will text on touchdown.- Samantha (11:40) — self-arranged car; meet at main lobby, I will greet at 11:55.

2) AV / IT- AV vendor: BluePeak AV (on contract) — primary contact: Rafael Mendes (cell: +1 510-555-0432).- IT: we will provision an isolated demo VLAN and a temporary host account for one guest laptop. Rafael will confirm cable set, AppleTV standby, and clicker.

3) Badges & building access- Monica: badges ready by 08:00; security desk will issue temporary PIVs for visitors that need elevator access to 23rd floor.

4) CNDA- Graham — we have a standard Redwood CNDA we can hand-sign on arrival; if Hearthwell prefers your agreement, please upload to the Drive link and we can route for day-of signature.

Monica, Rafael, and Vanessa — looping you here so any changes can be updated in the shared Drive. I'll bring hard copies of the RoS and attendee booklet.

Laura Bennett
Executive Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0123
From: Graham Ellis <g.ellis@hearthwell.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, Samantha Cruz <s.cruz@hearthwell.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hearthwell exec day — arrival details & requirements

Perfect — appreciate the quick coordination. A couple of final asks before we close the loop: 

- Can you share the secure-VLAN test account credentials at least 24 hours out so our security team can pre-validate? If you prefer, we can run the validation remotely with Rafael.
- One attendee has a severe shellfish allergy — please make sure the plated lunch avoids cross-contact and that servers are aware.

We uploaded our preferred CNDA to the Drive link and also included a short regulatory checklist (SOC2 items called out) — can you confirm who will bring proof of SOC2 scope (if available) to hand to our compliance lead on the day?

Thanks again — see you Thursday.

Graham
